title: Web Application Fundamentals: HTTP, APIs & Debugging the Network
concept: Understand what really happens between the browser and the server: URLs, methods and status codes, headers and JSON, CORS, caching, cookies and sessions, timeouts and retries, each taught from a real bug on a learning platform and checked with evidence from the network.
description: A beginner course for anyone who builds or tests web applications and wants to stop guessing when a page breaks. Every lesson starts from an incident on the CodeDev learning platform - a progress page that shows yesterday's numbers, a login that works on one domain and fails on another, a retry loop that hammers a server that said no, a "CORS error" that is really an expired token - and fixes it by reading the request and the response: the request lifecycle, HTTP methods and status codes, DevTools, CORS, Cache-Control and ETags, cookies and sessions, timeouts and safe retries, UI states for every response, and REST basics. 10 lessons with quizzes on real network evidence and hands-on JavaScript challenges.

lessons.title: How a web request travels: URL, DNS, TLS & the response
How to pick the right HTTP method and status code
How to read a request in DevTools: headers, bodies & JSON
Why the browser blocks a response: CORS explained
HTTP caching: Cache-Control, ETag & stale pages
Cookies, sessions & when to answer 401 or 403
Timeouts & retries: which failures are safe to retry
Loading, error & empty states for every response
Debug the broken page: symptom, hypothesis, evidence, fix
REST API basics: resources, idempotency & error bodies
